note: All distributions, deviations, masses, and constraints are teaching assumptions.

injection.model: Central field; common apogee on equatorial node; target circular equatorial GEO.

propulsion.model: Constant thrust and Isp; no staging or ancillary consumption; scalar delivered D.

repeatability.model: Assigned deviations, not measurements. Known additive systematic error plus residual percent of nominal.
repeatability.note: Removing known bias is illustrative; it does not remove pulse-to-pulse deviations or prove future stability.

mixture.model: Illustrative bipropellant main engine and fuel-only backup; routing assumed as drawn.
mixture.note: Remaining fuel may serve the backup engine under the assumed routing; oxidizer cannot.
